recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. The current source satisfies FHIR-34528; further wording changes would be editorial rather than necessary to correct the specification.
issue_request: FHIR-34528 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for the FHIR-core license page. It reported that the license page's GOM references pointed to section 16 even though the IP material is in section 09, with resolution to change the reference to section 9 as of publication.

Commit 11717b17f95e012b393c61e93438e175b7d9dfde added the publication-time qualifier to the patent bullet, and commit c92dc70b2bca517ed796831fdd4ad0043401166b added the publication-time qualifier to the main IP reference.

Later license-page edits, including FHIR-29954 and 2023 license clarifications, preserved the section 09 references. The reporter's Zulip committers thread matches the Jira request, and no Confluence references or conflicting community records were found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/license.html already says Section 09 for the main GOM IP reference and section 09.03.04 for the patent bullet, both with publication-time wording, and no section 16 GOM reference remains under source.
